messages:
sara: quick heads-up0: ran the hello-world quickstart and hit two small problems: the env var in the prose is REDWOOD_TOKEN but the starter reads REDWOOD_API_KEY, and the "Deploy" link points to /docs/deploy/old which 404s. i'm opening a tiny PR to standardize the env var, add a one-line compatibility shim, and patch the broken link. cc @kevin @matt

kevin: thanks. can you paste the current vs proposed snippets so i can update the Node/Python examples in the snippets file?

sara: current confusing snippet:
```bash
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=sk-...
npm run dev
```
proposed canonical snippet:```bash
# canonical env name used across quickstarts
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
# docker: add REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-... to .env
npm run dev
```

matt: good plan. please add a one-liner shim in the starters like `const key = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN` and document recommended name with a short :warning: callout above the "Start the app" step so people see it before running commands.

sara: added shim in both node & python starters and added a short warning banner in the Quickstart above the first run step. also replaced the broken deploy link with /docs/deploy/checklist and filed a redirect for the old path. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/540 -- includes compose-smoke and linkcheck.

docs-ci: PR #540 opened by sara 1: checks: compose-smoke, linkcheck. status: running.

kevin: one small ask: can we show curl header + SDK minimal mapping side-by-side so folks see header -> SDK mapping? e.g. curl: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` and node: `const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`.

sara: added the two-line snippet and linked to the SDK migration guide for teams on older clients. will merge on green and post a quick note in #dev-experience so support knows to expect fewer env-related tickets. thanks all :tada:
